tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Look up WHOIS/RDAP data for a domain: registration state (registered / available / reserved / unsupported / unknown) and the full raw registry record (registrar, dates, name servers, status). Supports 1400+ zones including IDN / Cyrillic domains.

tools.name: ip_geolocation
tools.description: Geolocate an IPv4/IPv6 address: country, region, city, ISP and organisation.

tools.name: punycode_convert
tools.description: Convert a domain between Unicode (IDN) and Punycode/ACE (xn--) form, both directions, auto-detected.
